nodes.title: Sunny Chuxem Character Description
widgets_values: A high-fidelity cinematic 3D mascot character named Sunny Chuxem, bold clean line art outlines. The main body is a perfect, single, massive volumetric sphere resembling a brilliant blinding sun, completely constructed of a highly detailed, realistic, fluidly bubbling red-orange molten rock magma texture with an intense internal solar flare glow and bright moving liquid lava surface patterns, resembling the raw plasma surface of the sun with no dark dried crust. There is absolutely NO human torso, NO chest, NO neck, and NO human shoulders. Two simple, thin, realistic glowing orange magma arms attach and extend directly out from the left and right sides of the main round sun body sphere, ending in bare orange magma hands. The arms and hands are completely vibrant orange and glowing with no silver skin, no metallic arms, and zero gray colors on the limbs. Each orange hand is actively holding a single, traditional, self-contained martial arts nunchuck weapon. Each nunchuck consists of exactly two separate, identical silver metallic cylindrical rods of the exact same length and size. One rod is held in the hand, and the second matching identical rod floats horizontally nearby within the frame. The twin matching silver rods are securely connected to each other by a small, tight, heavy silver metallic connector chain consisting of exactly five distinct interconnected oval chain links looping completely inside the camera frame. A thick wide athletic sweatband made of crisp solid white cloth fabric is wrapped horizontally around the upper forehead section of his perfect large spherical body. The face features large, crisp, perfectly round hollow circle eyes with NO pupils, a wide open crescent-shaped smiling mouth, both eyes and mouth glowing intensely with bright, pure white blinding sunlight energy pouring out from inside the hollow sphere. Two simple, thin, realistic glowing magma legs attach and extend directly out from the absolute bottom base of the main round sun body sphere. His feet are wrapped inside a perfectly uniform, matching pair of identical low-top athletic basketball shoe footwear structures that are exactly the same style, shape, and design on both sides. The character's left foot wears a left-facing shoe and the character's right foot wears a right-facing shoe, keeping them perfectly symmetrical, identical, and facing outwards to the sides of the frame. Both matching shoes are constructed entirely out of a metallic hardened silver rock magma material texture with zero fabric components, no laces, and no casual shoe features.
